_comment: Expansion 3 part D.4: level 8 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Spells that wait for Part E or F are not here.

antimagic_field.name: Antimagic Field
antimagic_field.text: An aura of antimagic 10 feet around you (concentration, an hour) goes where you go: nobody in it, you too, can cast a spell, and no spell can reach in from outside to touch one who stands in it. Dispel Magic cannot end it.

befuddlement.name: Befuddlement
befuddlement.text: You blast the mind of a foe within 150 feet: an Intelligence save or 10d12 psychic damage (half on a save). On a failure it also cannot cast spells or use magic actions for the rest of the fight, and the day.

dominate_monster.name: Dominate Monster
dominate_monster.text: A creature of any kind within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, with advantage while you fight it, or falls under your will (concentration, an hour) and fights on your side. Each time it is hurt it saves again, and a success breaks the hold.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.text: An intense tremor rips through a circle 100 feet in radius, up to 500 feet away (concentration, a minute). The ground is rough going. Foes there, or who step in, make a Dexterity save or fall prone and lose their concentration. Your friends are spared.

holy_aura.name: Holy Aura
holy_aura.text: A holy light 30 feet around you (concentration, a minute): you and your friends in it have advantage on every saving throw and foes have disadvantage on attacks against you. A fiend or undead that strikes one of you in melee makes a Constitution save or is blinded.

incendiary_cloud.name: Incendiary Cloud
incendiary_cloud.text: A swirling cloud of embers and smoke fills a 20-foot radius up to 150 feet away (concentration, a minute), thick enough to hide in: all caught, or who walk in or end a turn there, make a Dexterity save or take 10d8 fire, half on a save. The cloud does not drift.

maze.name: Maze
maze.text: You banish a creature within 60 feet into a labyrinth (concentration, ten minutes). There is no save. Each turn it spends hunting the way out is a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check; on a success it escapes and the spell ends.

mind_blank.name: Mind Blank
mind_blank.text: A willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage and cannot be charmed, for a day.

power_word_stun.name: Power Word Stun
power_word_stun.text: A word overwhelms a foe within 60 feet. With 150 hit points or fewer it is stunned, and makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to shake it off. With more, it cannot move until your next turn. There is no save against the word.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.text: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius up to 150 feet away: everyone in it, friend or foe, makes a Constitution save or takes 12d6 radiant and is blinded for a minute (a save at each turn's end may free it); half damage on a save.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.text: A wall of water bursts across the field along a line 300 feet long (concentration, six rounds): everyone it sweeps over makes a Strength save or takes 6d10 bludgeoning and is flung 50 feet along its course; half damage on a save.
